chunks: Whatever was in it from Saʿīd al-Naqqāsh, I have narrated it from Muḥammad ibn Mūsā ibn al-Mutawakkil—may Allah be pleased with him—from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn al-Saʿdābādī, from Aḥmad ibn Abī ʿAbd Allāh al-Barqī, from his father, from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from Saʿīd al-Naqqāsh.
ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain of Shaykh al-Ṣadūq to Saʿīd al-Naqqāsh in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage is a sanad/isnad notice in which the author clarifies his transmission route to Saʿīd al-Naqqāsh. Its significance lies in hadith documentation, identifying the chain through which material in the book was received.
